# FG-AIASSET-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`ai-asset-rollback`](../../ops/runbooks/ai-asset-rollback.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `withdraw_twice_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この AI 資産のリリースは取り下げられません。版がないか、すでに取り下げ済みか、理由が書かれていません。
- en: This AI asset release cannot be withdrawn: there is no such version, it is withdrawn already, or the reason is missing.
- id: Rilis aset AI ini tidak dapat ditarik: versinya tidak ada, sudah ditarik, atau alasannya belum diisi.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-7b (ADR-0031 Amendment P17-7b): `POST …/ai-asset-releases/{version}/withdrawal` (or `gstn ai-asset release-withdraw`) marks a bad pfs-ai-bundle release withdrawn, for good, with a reason (one append-only row of forge.ai_bundle_withdrawals). `reason`: `release_not_found` (no release of that version in the project), `already_withdrawn` (a withdrawal row exists: a withdrawal is never repeated or undone), `reason_invalid` (the reason is empty, longer than 500 characters or holds a control character), `rollback_target_running` (with `environment`: a deployment running there now fixed this release as the version it rolls back to on a failure; withdraw again when it has ended). Who may withdraw was decided before (AiAssetReleaseWithdraw: people only, Maintainer and above). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route logs `forge.deploy.bundle_withdraw_refused` with `error_code=FG-AIASSET-0010`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `version` and `reason`. Read: SELECT r.version, w.reason, w.withdrawn_by, w.withdrawn_at FROM forge.ai_bundle_releases r LEFT JOIN forge.ai_bundle_withdrawals w ON w.release_id = r.id WHERE r.project_id = <id> ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 20;

## 対処 (fix)

Check the version (`gstn ai-asset releases --project <id>`). rollback_target_running: wait until the running deployment of that environment ends (minutes), then withdraw again. A withdrawn release stays withdrawn: make a new release (a new tag) with the fix. Write a reason of 1 to 500 characters on one line.
